subject: Request: interim coverage letter + SOC 2 evidence for procurement
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@heliostat.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-10T09:12:34Z
Subject: SOC 2 + interim commitment for procurement

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking our call yesterday. Our procurement team has started the security review and flagged that we need a copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a written interim commitment (sometimes called a "bridge letter") that covers the period after your report end date through the current date.

Specifically, they asked for:
- SOC 2 Type II report (period ending 2026-06-30)
- A letter stating whether there have been material changes to controls since 2026-07-01 and that controls supporting the scope continued to operate through present (we need the coverage to 2026-10-05)
- High-level evidence references for KMS/key rotation, incident response status, and retention policies (we don't need raw keys, just artifacts and sign-offs)

Could you confirm whether you can provide the above and an ETA? Also let us know if you can provide a DocuSign-ready version of the letter for our records. Procurement prefers to have the signed package before our security committee meeting on 2026-10-12.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Laura Chen
Procurement Lead
Heliostat Systems

Attachments: none

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@heliostat.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-11T10:45:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 + interim commitment for procurement

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide the SOC 2 Type II report and prepare an interim coverage letter that covers 2026-07-01 through a requested date. Draft plan:

1) Share certified SOC 2 Type II (report end date 2026-06-30) — PDF attached.
2) Prepare an interim coverage letter (we'll propose coverage through 2026-10-05 to align with your ask) and provide it as a DocuSign-ready PDF.
3) Include an evidence package that references KMS key rotation summary, sample audit logs (redacted), and a controls operating statement.

I'll loop in our compliance and legal teams to draft and approve the language. Can you confirm whether the security committee needs the signatory to be the VP of Security (Naomi Feldman) or if a senior compliance representative is acceptable? Also confirm whether the DocuSign needs to list Heliostat's contact name for signature routing.

ETA: We can send a draft letter + evidence index by 2026-09-15 and a signed bundle by 2026-10-05. If you need it sooner, let me know and I'll escalate.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-1284

Attachments referenced: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_20260630.pdf (attached)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-11T10:46:12Z
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 + interim commitment for procurement (Heliostat) — need draft

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Heliostat's ask. Can you help with the following:

- Marissa: please draft an interim coverage letter that references our SOC 2 Type II report (end date 2026-06-30), proposes coverage from 2026-07-01 to 2026-10-05, and includes the standard para: "No material changes to the controls within scope of the report have occurred that would materially affect the operating effectiveness..." Make the language procurement-friendly and avoid operational metrics.
- Rishi: please review for legal/regulatory wording; if acceptable, route to Naomi Feldman for signature.

We should also prepare an evidence index: KMS key rotation summary (pdf), sample redacted KV cache logs (csv), and our retention policy excerpt. I'll ask Laura for the exact signer name to include in the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks — Vanessa

(On a related note: Marissa, are we OK to include a short section saying "evidence available upon request" vs attaching full logs?)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-12T15:03:12Z
Subject: Draft: Interim coverage letter (Heliostat) — suggested language

Vanessa / Rishi,

Attached below is the suggested body for the interim coverage letter. I kept it concise to satisfy procurement reviewers. Please review and flag any legal edits.

--- DRAFT LETTER TEXT START ---
Redwood Inference
Attention: Procurement / Security Review

Re: Interim Coverage Statement for SOC 2 Type II Report (Report Period Ended 30 June 2026)

To Whom It May Concern,

Redwood Inference confirms that the SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 30 June 2026 remains the most recent report issued for the controls in scope. From 1 July 2026 through 5 October 2026, Redwood Inference is not aware of any material changes to the design or operating effectiveness of the controls included within the scope of that report that would reasonably be expected to materially alter the conclusions in the SOC 2 report.

Supporting evidence that may be provided upon request includes:
- KMS key rotation summary and sign-off records
- Sample redacted audit logs demonstrating access controls and KV cache management
- Retention and incident response policy excerpts and last tabletop date

This statement is provided for the exclusive use of Heliostat Systems for their internal security review.

Sincerely,

Naomi Feldman
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
--- DRAFT LETTER TEXT END ---

Notes: I left a placeholder for the DocuSign routing name. If we're comfortable with this wording, Rishi — please advise on any legal tweaks and I'll convert to a DocuSign-ready PDF.

Marissa
Senior Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-13T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Draft: Interim coverage letter (Heliostat) — suggested language

Thanks Marissa — language looks good overall. A couple of small edits I recommend:
- Replace "not aware of any material changes" with "no material changes have been identified" to be slightly more affirmative but not absolute.
- Add a single sentence that the statement does not constitute an update to the SOC 2 report itself and does not expand the scope.

After those edits, please convert to PDF and prepare DocuSign metadata. Naomi should be the signatory; Naomi, please confirm you are available to sign the week of 2026-10-05.

Rishi
Legal Counsel | Redwood Inference
